authorship_and_QA: Original Vietnamese LLM-authored candidates. Author read complete tasks/references/rubrics and verified all declared exact checks; no human certification.

qa.grade_placement: Author checked natural-number prerequisites by grade; grade2 division stays within the two/five tables; formal fractions are grade4 and decimals are grade5. This is placement QA, not curriculum certification.

locked_test_protocol.paired_contract_if_baseline_is_reported: If a baseline is preregistered, run it in the same final one-time locked evaluation session using the same prompts/decoding; do not use outcomes for selection.

reporting: Report aggregate grade/mode counts and full-output semantic failures only after selection. Preserve raw outputs and prompt/token/decoding contract hashes; no human or full-curriculum certification. Correct answers with contradictory explanations fail strict task success; useful answer-free guidance is required in hint mode.
